title: VoiceStudio: free ElevenLabs alternative
caption:
ElevenLabs charges $6/month. VoiceStudio does the same job for free 🎙️

✅ Clone a voice from a clean recording
✅ Design a new voice just by describing it
✅ Dub videos, 646 languages
✅ Runs on your own computer, no subscription, 100% free

Comment "VOICE" and I'll DM you the link 🔗

Follow @itsongit for a new free open-source find every day
